title: Console API: shadow experiments CRUD + aggregates endpoints (RBAC, pagination)
author: Chloe Martin
body: Summary: Implements Console backend endpoints to create/update/query Shadow Experiments and fetch quality/latency/cost aggregates for Console drilldowns. This is the first public-facing server API for shadow experiments; UI work will follow behind a feature flag. Motivation: Beta customers requested a safe way to attach quality signals to rollouts without impacting user traffic; this PR unblocks dogfood and Dedicated beta by providing stable CRUD + query primitives with strict RBAC and cardinality-safe filters. API surface (v1, behind feature flag `shadow_experiments_api`): POST /v1/shadow-experiments (create), GET /v1/shadow-experiments (list w/ cursor pagination), GET /v1/shadow-experiments/:id (details), PATCH /v1/shadow-experiments/:id (mutate mutable fields only), POST /v1/shadow-experiments/:id:archive (soft-archive), GET /v1/shadow-experiments/:id/aggregates (time-windowed metric deltas + confidence intervals stub), GET /v1/shadow-experiments/:id/examples (sampled paired examples; gated + capped). RBAC: Requires `rollouts:write` for create/mutate/archive; `rollouts:read` for list/get/aggregates. Access is tenant-scoped; Dedicated sub-org scoping enforced via `org_id` + `project_id`. Additionally, `examples` endpoint requires `quality:read_sensitive` to reduce accidental prompt/response exposure. Pagination/filtering: List uses opaque cursor (base64) with stable ordering by created_at,id. Filters supported: route_id, rollout_id, state (active|archived), created_after/before, tag (low-cardinality). Hard caps: limit <= 200; default 50. Aggregates endpoint supports fixed bucket sizes (5m/1h/1d) and clamps time range to retention window; rejects arbitrary group-by dimensions to avoid metric blowups. Data model: Adds `shadow_experiments` and `shadow_experiment_targets` tables (one control + N shadow targets) and stores only non-sensitive config references (route_id, rollout_id, policy_ref, rubric_version, sampling_rate, metadata allowlist). No prompt/response payload storage is added here (handled by telemetry pipeline); `examples` endpoint reads from the shadow artifacts service via signed references and returns redacted fields only. Validation: Enforces sampling_rate bounds, target uniqueness, and immutability rules (cannot change control target or bucketing salt after activation). Also validates that referenced route is eligible for shadowing (streaming behavior allowed but marked `partial_capture=true`). Observability: Adds request logs + metrics for endpoint QPS/latency and a counter for RBAC denials; aggregates endpoint emits `shadow_console_api_aggregate_requests_total{status}`. Testing: Unit tests for validators + pagination cursor codec; integration tests for RBAC and tenancy boundaries; contract-style tests for list filters; added a small seed helper for local dev. Notes/Follow-ups: (1) Aggregate confidence intervals currently return placeholder fields when the scoring pipeline hasn’t produced CI; Console will render “insufficient data” until ENG-5405/ENG-5406 complete. (2) Audit log entries for create/update/archive are wired, but the expanded audit event schema will land in a dedicated PR (ENG-5417).
commits: console-api: add shadow experiments router + handlers
rbac: enforce rollouts read/write + sensitive quality permission
pagination: cursor codec + stable ordering + filter plumbing
aggregates: metrics query stub + retention window clamping
tests: RBAC/tenancy integration tests + validator unit tests
docs: internal README for local testing + curl examples
conversation: Dylan Brooks (review): Can we make sure list pagination is stable across inserts? Also please confirm which fields are mutable post-activation; we should prevent changing targets after we’ve started collecting data.

Chloe Martin (author): Updated ordering to (created_at DESC, id DESC) and cursor now encodes both. Added immutability rules: control_target, bucketing_salt, and target set are frozen once state=active; PATCH only allows name/description/labels and alert thresholds.

Jada Williams (review): For rollout linkage, can we enforce that rollout_id belongs to the same project and that the referenced route is the rollout’s route? Otherwise we’ll end up with confusing attachments in the timeline.

Chloe Martin (author): Added validation: if rollout_id is set, route_id must match rollout.route_id and both must be in the same project_id. Also added a 400 with a specific error code `ROLL_OUT_ROUTE_MISMATCH`.

Marcus Lin (review - security): The `examples` endpoint is a footgun. It needs stronger permissioning and a hard cap, and we should ensure we only return redacted fields. Also please confirm we aren’t storing prompts in the console DB.

Chloe Martin (author): Agreed. `examples` now requires `quality:read_sensitive`, limit <= 20, and response only includes `request_id`, `fingerprint`, `control_summary`, `shadow_summary`, and `redaction_applied=true`. No prompt text is stored in console DB; we only fetch by signed artifact refs from the shadow artifacts service.

Allison Grant (review - obs): Aggregates endpoint should not accept arbitrary groupBy dimensions; can we lock it down to the few dashboards we plan and add a metric so we can see if it’s being hammered?

Chloe Martin (author): Locked down. Only supports `bucket=5m|1h|1d` and optional filter `target_id`. Added `shadow_console_api_aggregate_requests_total` and request duration histogram; also added clamping to retention window and returns `RETENTION_CLAMPED` flag.
Paula Mendes (product): Any chance we can include archived state and tags for beta so PMs can manage experiments from Console without deleting them?
Chloe Martin (author): Added soft-archive action and low-cardinality labels (max 10, key/value length caps). Delete is intentionally not supported in v1.
Dylan Brooks (review): One more: make sure we return consistent error codes for RBAC denials so Console can render the right empty state.
Chloe Martin (author): Added `ERR_FORBIDDEN_RBAC` and `ERR_FORBIDDEN_TENANT_SCOPE` codes; updated tests.
Dylan Brooks (approval): LGTM once CI is green.
Marcus Lin (approval): Approved with the new permission gate + caps.
Allison Grant (approval): Approved; thanks for locking down dimensions.
release_notes: Internal-only (feature-flagged): adds Console backend API for shadow experiments (CRUD, list pagination, aggregates + example sampling endpoints) with strict RBAC and retention-aware query clamping.
